name: Claude Fable 5.2 精选集

lead.zh: 这是 Claude Fable 5.2 的 10 件来源子集，不是另一个模型。优先选能打开、近期、原作者 / 原帖 / 源码可核的作品；不是排行榜，也不把点赞当能力结论。
lead.en: This is a ten-piece source subset of Claude Fable 5.2, not another model. Pieces were picked for openability, recency and traceability to the author, post or source; this is not a leaderboard, and likes are not a capability verdict.

titleZh: Claude Fable 5.2 精选集：10 个 HTML 视觉研究
titleEn: Claude Fable 5.2 selection: 10 HTML visual studies

leadZh: 6 个站内可运行的办公提示词生成器：会议纪要、PPT 大纲、表格口径、邮件日程、翻译术语、合同风险。输入你的材料，生成可复制的结构化提示词。
leadEn: Six runnable office prompt builders: meeting minutes, deck outline, spreadsheet definitions, email/schedule, translation glossary and contract risk. Fill in your material and copy a structured prompt.

leadZh: 6 个站内可运行的教学与数据提示词生成器：备课、出题评分、课堂追问、数据清洗、数据卡、RAG 语料。每个都带教师/分析师复核点。
leadEn: Six runnable teaching and data prompt builders: lesson plan, question rubric, classroom probing, data cleaning, dataset card and RAG corpus. Each keeps a teacher/analyst checkpoint.
